2 BEDROOM FIRST FLOOR APARTMENT IN EXCLUSIVE DEVELOPMENT IN THE HEART OF DUN LAOGHAIRE.

Superb 2 bedroom first floor apartment. Wonderful unit with its own front door and patio. One designated underground secure parking space.

St Helens Court (built in 2000) is an exclusive modern duplex development with 26 fabulous apartments. 

The apartment is well presented with two bedrooms, a fabulous open plan living space and benefits from Electric Heating.

Saint Helen's Court occupies an enviable site on Lower George's Street, a fabulous bustling area in the Town Centre.

George's Street is located close to the sea front and is a highly sought after location. The area is served by extensive public transport links with numerous bus routes close by including the Aircoach and Dun Laoghaire's Dart station, just a short walk away offering easy access to Dublin city centre. Dublin's M50 ring road is also easily accessible.

Special Features

Superb 2 bedroom unit
Secure underground parking
Electric Heating
Double Glazed Windows
Beautiful communal court yard
Located close to sea front
Convenient to DART station
In the heart to Dun Laoghaire Town Centre
Stone's throw to Dun Laoghaire's Yacht Clubs
Short walk to People's Park
Close to Monkstown and Sandycove
Management Company - St. Helen's Court George Street Owners Management Company Limited by Guarantee
Management Agent - Qualitas
